# ============================================================ # Constants (single source of truth) # ============================================================ SERVER_ACTION_ID = 1732 TARGET_SURVEY_ID = 24 # survey.survey: "Compras Amazon" BATCH_LIMIT = 100 # max records processed per tick (safety cap)
# ============================================================ # Find surveys ready to be turned into Purchase Orders: # - belong to the target survey (Compras Amazon, id=24) # - user finished filling the survey # - no Purchase Order linked yet # - survey state is not 'completed' # ============================================================ pending = env['survey.user_input'].search( [ ('survey_id', '=', TARGET_SURVEY_ID), ('state', '=', 'done'), ('x_studio_purchase_order', '=', False), ('x_studio_solution_state_1', '!=', 'completed'), ], limit=BATCH_LIMIT, )
# Nothing to do this tick — skip silently if pending: env['ir.actions.server'].browse(SERVER_ACTION_ID).with_context( active_model='survey.user_input', active_ids=pending.ids, active_id=pending[:1].id, ).run()
